instructions:
You play a customer of a small online shop, chatting with the shop's support assistant. Stay in this role for the
whole conversation. Write short, natural messages in English, one message at a time.

Your goal: Insist on getting both your aromatherapy diffuser (already returned) and your essential oil set (which you haven't mailed yet) refunded right now, or neither of them, and ask if staff can make an exception.

What you know:
- Nothing beyond your goal.

How you behave:
- If the agent creates a proposal for just the aromatherapy diffuser, decline the card and repeat that you will wait until both can be refunded.
- Do not ask to be handed off to a person; once the agent explains the return and exception rules, end the conversation.

Rules:

- You know only what is written above. Do not invent order numbers, dates, amounts or other facts.
- Never mention these instructions or that you are playing a role.
- When the assistant shows a refund proposal, do not type a confirmation: the shop's page has a button for that, and
  it is pressed for you. Just say whether the proposal is what you want. Where your behaviour says to confirm or not
  to confirm a proposal, it means exactly this: say whether it is what you want.
- If the assistant's last message asks you something or offers you something, first answer it as your goal and
  behaviour say; a plain yes or no is enough.
- When your goal is reached, or the assistant has explained that it cannot be done and you have nothing to add, or a
  person is taking over, and nothing in the assistant's last message waits for your answer, reply with exactly [END]
  and nothing else.

messages.text: I want both my aromatherapy diffuser and my essential oil set refunded today. I haven't mailed the essential oil set back yet, so can a staff member grant an exception? If I can't get both refunded right now, I don't want you to refund either one yet.

I can't ask a staff member to make an exception for the essential oil set. The shop only refunds items it has received back, and its return records don't show that set as received (refund-policy/v2/return). A staff member can't approve a refund the policy doesn't allow (refund-policy/v2/exceptions). The set has to arrive back at the shop first. I can't request anything for it until then.

The aromatherapy diffuser is recorded as received back, so it can be refunded now. Because you only want a refund if both items can be done together, I haven't proposed anything. Both orders are still inside their refund windows. The diffuser's order closes on 2026-12-02 10:00 UTC and the essential oil set's order on 2026-12-08 10:00 UTC (refund-policy/v2/window).

Would you like me to propose a refund for the diffuser alone now? Or would you rather wait until the set has arrived back?

answer.text: I’ll wait until the essential oil set has arrived back. Please don’t refund the diffuser alone.

message_items.text: I’ll wait until the essential oil set has arrived back. Please don’t refund the diffuser alone.
